summary: Iteration 6 — Payment persistence bug fix (email-based restore) — ALL PASS. Backend (9/9 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_payment_persistence_iter6.py): (a) POST /api/payments/checkout without email → 400 with 'email' in error; with 'notanemail' → 400; with mixed-case email → 200 and payment_transactions doc persists email in lowercase (normalized via .strip().lower()). (b) POST /api/payments/restore with invalid email → 400 'Email inválido'; with unpaid email → {has_access:false}; with seeded paid tx email + NEW device_id → {has_access:true} AND creates access_grants row {device_id, email, source_tx, granted_at}; subsequent GET /api/payments/access/{new_device_id} → {has_access:true} (via access_grants). (c) Restore is idempotent — second call keeps a single access_grants row (upsert working). (d) Regression: /api/payments/access still works via payment_transactions for the ORIGINAL device_id that paid. FRONTEND E2E (mobile viewport 390x844): paywall renders with pay-email-input always visible and restore-button always visible; tapping unlock-button with empty email shows 'Ingresa un email válido: es tu respaldo para recuperar la compra.'; restore-button 2-step flow works — 1st tap reveals restore-email-input, 2nd tap verifies; unknown email → 'No encontramos un pago con ese email.'; **CENTRAL BUG FIX VERIFIED**: with a paid tx seeded in Mongo for email e2e_restore_test@rapanui.cl, a fresh browser (device_id newly generated, no rapa-nui-paid flag) restored access via restore-email-input → navigated to /map WITHOUT paying again + set localStorage rapa-nui-paid=true. Additionally, after removing only rapa-nui-paid flag and reloading /, the app still redirected to /map (confirming /api/payments/access/{device_id} now checks access_grants correctly — the exact iOS/Safari data-wipe scenario). navigator.storage.persist() is called silently on mount — 0 storage/persist related console errors observed. The Stripe live-checkout leg was attempted but stripe.com's automated checkout completion is flaky in headless (submit did not settle) — the checkout redirect itself succeeded (checkout.stripe.com URL confirmed) and card fields filled; since backend already validates that Stripe checkout stores email lowercase (test_checkout_with_valid_email_stores_lowercase), the paid→wipe→restore chain was proven via a seeded paid tx which is functionally equivalent.

rca_of_issue: Original bug: iOS Safari periodically clears localStorage → device_id + rapa-nui-paid flag lost → app treated user as new, forcing them to pay again while /api/payments/access/{new_device_id} returned false. Fix (verified working): (1) capture email pre-checkout and persist it in payment_transactions.email (lowercase), (2) POST /api/payments/restore looks up any paid tx by email and mints an access_grants row linking the CURRENT (post-wipe) device_id to the original paid tx, (3) /api/payments/access/{device_id} now checks access_grants in addition to payment_transactions, (4) UI surfaces a persistent 'Restaurar acceso con tu email' link + email input in a 2-step reveal, (5) navigator.storage.persist() politely asks the browser to keep data. Reproduction on the preview: seed a paid tx for email X, open / in a fresh browser (or clear localStorage), tap 'Restaurar acceso' → enter X → tap 'Verificar y restaurar acceso' → redirects to /map with rapa-nui-paid=true. Mitigation for users already stuck: they only need to remember the email they used at checkout; no support ticket required.
